title: Beating funeral dirges and why funerals need chosen drummers
summary: Robertson demonstrates the funeral beat, explains the snare drummer leading and the bass drum following, and says he is often hired for funerals.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Jazz funerals: dirges, hot return, second line
